home.description: Software engineer focused on building clean interfaces for the web, solid backends, and tools that actually solve problems.
home.intro: I specialize in building robust backend systems and clean frontend interfaces for the web. With a degree in Software Engineering from PUC PR and hands-on experience in Clean Architecture, DDD, and TDD, I bring both theoretical foundation and practical skills to every project I work on.
home.featuredProjectDesc: Code&Go API — a backend for an educational platform that teaches programming through gamification, built with Clean Architecture, DDD, CQRS, and C#. Includes CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker.
home.approachDesc: I believe great software is built on clear thinking, clean code, and honest communication. Whether working solo or in a team, I try to write code that is easy to understand, easy to change, and built to last.

about.title: About me
about.bio1: I'm Lucas Augusto da Silva, a Software Engineer based in Curitiba, Brazil. I completed my degree in Software Engineering at PUC PR, where I built a strong foundation in software design and architecture.
about.bio2: I care deeply about writing code that is clean, intentional, and built to last. My studies in Domain-Driven Design, Clean Code, and TDD aren't just academic — they shape how I approach every project.
about.bio3: I'm genuinely passionate about software and the craft behind it. I believe the best engineers never stop learning — whether that's diving into a new architecture pattern, exploring a different language, or taking on a problem that pushes me outside my comfort zone. Challenge is where growth happens, and I've never shied away from it.
about.workingOnDesc: Personal tools that make everyday dev workflows faster.
about.basedInDesc: Curitiba, Brazil — available for remote work worldwide.
about.studyingDesc: Taking the AZ-900 to formally certify my Azure knowledge.
